mapper.sql: , author_relation AS ( SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.achievement_id) AS achievement_id, COALESCE(author_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.author_id) AS author_id FROM achievement_author relation_value LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = relation_value.achievement_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link author_link ON author_link.entity_type = 'AUTHOR' AND author_link.entity_id = relation_value.author_id JOIN scoped_achievement filtered_scope ON filtered_scope.id = COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.achievement_id) )

, organization_relation AS ( SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.achievement_id) AS achievement_id, COALESCE(organization_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.organization_id) AS organization_id FROM authorship_organization relation_value LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = relation_value.achievement_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link organization_link ON organization_link.entity_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND organization_link.entity_id = relation_value.organization_id JOIN scoped_achievement filtered_scope ON filtered_scope.id = COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.achievement_id) )

, source_relation AS ( SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.achievement_id) AS achievement_id, relation_value.source_id FROM achievement_source relation_value LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = relation_value.achievement_id WHERE COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.achievement_id) IN (SELECT id FROM scoped_achievement) )

, topic_relation AS ( SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.achievement_id) AS achievement_id, relation_value.subject_id FROM achievement_subject relation_value LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = relation_value.achievement_id JOIN scoped_achievement filtered_scope ON filtered_scope.id = COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.achievement_id) )
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scoped_achievement) AS achievement_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT author_id) FROM author_relation) AS author_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT organization_id) FROM organization_relation) AS organization_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT source_id) FROM source_relation) AS source_count

, source_signals AS ( SELECT COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, source_value.achievement_id) AS achievement_id, MAX(JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot.normalized_payload, '$.scholarlyMetadata.citedByCount')) = 'INTEGER') AS has_citation_count, MAX(JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot.normalized_payload, '$.scholarlyMetadata.openAccess')) = 'BOOLEAN') AS has_open_access_status, MAX(JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(snapshot.normalized_payload, '$.scholarlyMetadata.retracted')) = 'BOOLEAN') AS has_retraction_status FROM achievement_source source_value JOIN achievement_source_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.achievement_source_id = source_value.id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link member_link ON member_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND member_link.entity_id = source_value.achievement_id JOIN scoped_achievement scope_value ON scope_value.id = COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, source_value.achievement_id) GROUP BY COALESCE(member_link.canonical_entity_id, source_value.achievement_id) ) SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN a.doi_normalized IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS with_doi_count, COUNT(scoped.publication_year) AS with_publication_year_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(detail.abstract_text)) > 0 THEN 1 END) AS with_abstract_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN signals.has_citation_count = TRUE THEN 1 END) AS with_citation_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN signals.has_open_access_status = TRUE THEN 1 END) AS with_open_access_status_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN signals.has_retraction_status = TRUE THEN 1 END) AS with_retraction_status_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN detail.authorships_may_be_incomplete = TRUE THEN 1 END) AS authorships_may_be_incomplete_count FROM scoped_achievement scoped JOIN achievement a ON a.id = scoped.id LEFT JOIN paper_detail detail ON detail.achievement_id = scoped.id LEFT JOIN source_signals signals ON signals.achievement_id = scoped.id
SELECT publication_year, COUNT(*) AS achievement_count FROM scoped_achievement WHERE publication_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publication_year ORDER BY publication_year

SELECT COALESCE(achievement_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS item_key, COALESCE(achievement_type, '未知') AS item_label, COUNT(*) AS achievement_count FROM scoped_achievement GROUP BY achievement_type ORDER BY achievement_count DESC, item_key

SELECT source_value.source_code AS item_key, source_value.source_code AS item_label, COUNT(DISTINCT scoped.id) AS achievement_count FROM scoped_achievement scoped JOIN source_relation relation_value ON relation_value.achievement_id = scoped.id JOIN data_source source_value ON source_value.id = relation_value.source_id GROUP BY source_value.id, source_value.source_code ORDER BY achievement_count DESC, item_key

SELECT CAST(organization.id AS CHAR) AS item_key, COALESCE(organization.display_name, CONCAT('机构 ', organization.id)) AS item_label, COUNT(DISTINCT scoped.id) AS achievement_count FROM scoped_achievement scoped JOIN organization_relation relation_value ON relation_value.achievement_id = scoped.id JOIN organization ON organization.id = relation_value.organization_id GROUP BY organization.id, organization.display_name ORDER BY achievement_count DESC, organization.id LIMIT 20

SELECT CAST(subject.id AS CHAR) AS item_key, subject.display_name AS item_label, COUNT(DISTINCT scoped.id) AS achievement_count FROM scoped_achievement scoped JOIN topic_relation relation_value ON relation_value.achievement_id = scoped.id JOIN subject ON subject.id = relation_value.subject_id GROUP BY subject.id, subject.display_name ORDER BY achievement_count DESC, subject.id LIMIT 20

SELECT left_author.id AS left_id, COALESCE(left_author.display_name, CONCAT('作者 ', left_author.id)) AS left_label, right_author.id AS right_id, COALESCE(right_author.display_name, CONCAT('作者 ', right_author.id)) AS right_label, COUNT(DISTINCT scoped.id) AS shared_achievement_count FROM scoped_achievement scoped JOIN author_relation left_relation ON left_relation.achievement_id = scoped.id JOIN author_relation right_relation ON right_relation.achievement_id = scoped.id AND right_relation.author_id > left_relation.author_id JOIN author left_author ON left_author.id = left_relation.author_id JOIN author right_author ON right_author.id = right_relation.author_id GROUP BY left_author.id, left_author.display_name, right_author.id, right_author.display_name ORDER BY shared_achievement_count DESC, left_author.id, right_author.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT left_organization.id AS left_id, COALESCE(left_organization.display_name, CONCAT('机构 ', left_organization.id)) AS left_label, right_organization.id AS right_id, COALESCE(right_organization.display_name, CONCAT('机构 ', right_organization.id)) AS right_label, COUNT(DISTINCT scoped.id) AS shared_achievement_count FROM scoped_achievement scoped JOIN organization_relation left_relation ON left_relation.achievement_id = scoped.id JOIN organization_relation right_relation ON right_relation.achievement_id = scoped.id AND right_relation.organization_id > left_relation.organization_id JOIN organization left_organization ON left_organization.id = left_relation.organization_id JOIN organization right_organization ON right_organization.id = right_relation.organization_id GROUP BY left_organization.id, left_organization.display_name, right_organization.id, right_organization.display_name ORDER BY shared_achievement_count DESC, left_organization.id, right_organization.id LIMIT #{limit}
